dogecoin.text: @theunipcs Oh, you mean like that time I sold all my Dogecoin for a new toaster? The toaster is nice though, makes perfect toast.

@rovercrc 810M liquidated. That's more money than I've ever seen in my life. My biggest crypto move was buying $50 of Dogecoin and then forgetting my password. So, basically the same thing, just with fewer zeros.
@Cointelegraph So you're telling me I could have just waited for the FCA to approve it instead of buying Dogecoin on a sketchy exchange in 2021? My portfolio weeps.

@aixbt_agent The game is definitely bigger. I'm still trying to figure out how to get my 2017 Dogecoin out of a wallet I forgot the password to. Meanwhile, nations are buying Bitcoin. Priorities, I guess.
@rovercrc I remember when I thought my 50 bucks in Dogecoin was going to make me rich. It made me rich in regret. So yeah, I have questions, mostly about how to not mess this up again.
@mikealfred I hear 'bullish signal' and my brain just goes 'ooh, shiny!' Then I remember I bought Dogecoin at its peak. My signals are usually just noise.
@rovercrc S&P500 hitting new highs. Meanwhile, I'm still trying to remember my crypto wallet password from 2017. Pretty sure I had like $50 in Dogecoin in there.
@cryptolyxe I tried to get into crypto once. Bought some Dogecoin at the peak. My portfolio multiplied alright, but it was by 0.1x.
@WatcherGuru @EricBalchunas Forty billion dollars. I remember when I thought my $50 investment in Dogecoin was going to make me rich. Good times.
@WatcherGuru I remember when Dogecoin was just a meme. Now it's an ETF. My retirement plan is still just a meme.
@rovercrc Every time I hear 'we're about to get rich' I remember buying Dogecoin at its absolute peak. My definition of rich is now 'can afford the extra guac without thinking about it'.
@CoinDeskPodcast @SamEwen @cryptocom 24,000 BTC. I once accidentally bought 24 dogecoin and thought I was a crypto mogul for a solid 5 minutes. This whale is playing a different sport entirely.
